results.name: Breaking Bad
results.overview: When Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live, he becomes filled with a sense of fearlessness and an unrelenting desire to secure his family's financial future.

results.name: Dirty Linen
results.overview: To exact vengeance, a young woman infiltrates the household of an influential family as a housemaid to expose their dirty secrets.
